name: codex-home-manager-public-api-contract
note: This hosted contract mirrors the complete loopback connector API. The hosted static page cannot access Codex data until it connects to the local connector.

capabilities.name: auth_token
capabilities.purpose: Get the per-process token required for write endpoints. Browser access is restricted to the loopback same-origin local UI.

capabilities.name: diagnostics
capabilities.purpose: Run a read-only Codex Home health check covering local state, thread visibility, bundled plugin cache/config alignment, logs, storage and runtime process risks, and return a repairPrompt handoff for another Codex agent.

capabilities.name: preview_official_thread_tools_repair
capabilities.purpose: Preview fallback shadowing, non-contiguous registry positions, and incomplete initial rollout session_meta that can hide official codex_app tools.

capabilities.name: repair_official_thread_tools
capabilities.purpose: Repair initial rollout tool metadata, disable the legacy fallback, and normalize thread_dynamic_tools positions. JSONL repair is validated online; SQLite normalization requires Codex Desktop to be fully closed.
capabilities.backup: mandatory rollout backup for JSONL repair; optional home state backup for config/database rewrite
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: snapshot_threads
capabilities.purpose: List and classify all local Codex threads. Current Codex versions can show the full thread list; legacy first-page ordering is exposed only as compatibility metadata.

capabilities.name: get_thread_detail
capabilities.purpose: Read a target-only details shell from one SQLite row and one file stat without scanning the rollout or rebuilding the global snapshot.

capabilities.name: analyze_thread_detail
capabilities.purpose: Load JSONL statistics, visible-event integrity and backups for one thread after its fast details shell is visible. The request is cancellable.

capabilities.name: cancel_thread_detail_analysis
capabilities.purpose: Cancel an active detail analysis at the next JSONL record boundary.
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: daily_token_usage
capabilities.purpose: Read the per-day token timeline for one thread tree. Audited totals and peaks are derived from token_count events only. Threads with SQLite tokens_used but no token_count are marked as unknownTokenThreads; no token value is returned for them.

capabilities.name: read_thread_prompts
capabilities.purpose: Compatibility endpoint that returns a bounded page of classified user-role records. Use /prompts/page for filtering, cancellation and continued pagination.

capabilities.name: read_thread_prompt_page
capabilities.purpose: Incrementally index and page classified prompts with an opaque cursor, server-side search, source/scope filters, bounded cold-scan work and explicit completeness metadata.

capabilities.name: search_thread_timeline
capabilities.purpose: Incrementally index and search the complete natural-language conversation: user input, progress commentary, and final replies. Reasoning, tools, and context remain available through byte-cursor timeline search without entering the persistent full-text index.

capabilities.name: cancel_thread_timeline_search
capabilities.purpose: Cancel an active full-timeline indexing or search request.
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: cancel_thread_prompt_request
capabilities.purpose: Cancel an active prompt indexing or streaming request at the next JSONL record or SQLite fetch boundary.
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: copy_thread_prompts
capabilities.purpose: Stream filtered prompt text or NDJSON without materializing the complete result in process memory.
successFields: backup.backupId when the action writes state

capabilities.name: prompt_index_status
capabilities.purpose: Read prompt-index lifecycle metadata for one Codex Home. The response contains the local derived-index root plus counts, sizes, timestamps, retention limits, readability and in-use state; it never includes prompt text or source rollout paths.

capabilities.name: preview_clear_prompt_index
capabilities.purpose: Preview clearing the disposable prompt index for one Codex Home without returning prompt content.

capabilities.name: clear_prompt_index
capabilities.purpose: Clear the disposable prompt index for one Codex Home without modifying source rollouts. No cache backup is created because that would retain another copy of indexed prompt text.
capabilities.backup: no backup; the disposable index is rebuilt from source rollouts
capabilities.idempotency: idempotent; clearing an absent index is a no-op
capabilities.rollbackMode: not applicable; re-querying prompts rebuilds the index from source rollouts

capabilities.name: read_thread_timeline
capabilities.purpose: Read a semantic timeline from the JSONL tail without loading the complete rollout. Supports user input, assistant replies, readable reasoning, encrypted-reasoning markers, tool activity, search and byte-cursor pagination.

capabilities.name: read_thread_timeline_item
capabilities.purpose: Read the complete semantic content for one timeline record selected by its byteOffset.

capabilities.name: preview_thread_action
capabilities.purpose: Preview show, hide, repair, archive or duplicate before writing. Duplicate preview requires targetProjectPath.

capabilities.name: show_thread
capabilities.purpose: Restore a hidden or archived thread to Codex Desktop's visible indexes.
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: hide_thread
capabilities.purpose: Hide a visible main thread from Codex Desktop's visible indexes without archiving or deleting JSONL.
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: export_prompts
capabilities.purpose: Export prompts from a thread as markdown or json. Defaults to scope=pure, which exports only user-entered text; use scope=visible for user context too, scope=with_agents for subagent records, scope=automation for heartbeat/automation records, scope=delegation for messages sent from other Codex threads, or scope=all for complete records.
capabilities.backup: writes export file in workspace data/exports

capabilities.name: read_thread_logs
capabilities.purpose: Read structured rollout JSONL logs and Codex app logs_2.sqlite rows with pagination, source selection, search and filters for requests, failures, errors, events, tool calls and raw lines.

capabilities.name: duplicate_thread
capabilities.purpose: Copy one thread inside the current Codex Home with a new thread id and rollout JSONL into a selected target project path.
capabilities.backup: thread action backup before write; restore archives created copy
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: archive_thread
capabilities.purpose: Safe delete by archiving the thread without permanently deleting JSONL.
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: preview_migrate_thread
capabilities.purpose: Preview thread project migration before rewriting SQLite/global state/JSONL workspace metadata.

capabilities.name: migrate_thread
capabilities.purpose: Move a thread to another project path and rewrite structured workspace metadata in JSONL.
capabilities.backup: thread action backup before write; Codex must be closed
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: preview_move_thread_workspace
capabilities.purpose: Preview moving the selected thread, optional same-source-cwd threads, actual workspace files, SQLite/global state and rollout workspace metadata.

capabilities.name: move_thread_workspace
capabilities.purpose: Move the selected thread plus same-source-cwd threads and top-level workspace files to a target workspace. Codex Desktop and Codex CLI must be closed first.
capabilities.backup: thread/workspace move backup before write; Codex must be closed
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: slim_thread
capabilities.purpose: Reduce JSONL size only within the explicitly selected scope: removeImages, keepLatestCompacted, or both.
capabilities.backup: thread action backup before JSONL rewrite
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: preview_slim_thread
capabilities.purpose: Preview JSONL slimming impact for a selected scope without writing files.

capabilities.name: rename_project
capabilities.purpose: Rename project path metadata and optionally the local project folder. Codex Desktop and Codex CLI must be closed because they can rewrite sidebar cache state while running.
capabilities.backup: backs up all matched thread rows, rollout JSONLs, global state, global state backup and config
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: preview_rename_project
capabilities.purpose: Preview matched threads, rollout bytes, folder impact and whether running Codex blocks the project rename.

capabilities.name: import_thread_from_home
capabilities.purpose: Copy one thread from another Codex Home into the current Codex Home.
capabilities.backup: home state backup before import; restore archives imported thread
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: preview_import_thread_from_home
capabilities.purpose: Preview one source thread import without writing target home.

capabilities.name: import_project_from_home
capabilities.purpose: Copy all matched project threads from another Codex Home into the current Codex Home.
capabilities.backup: home state backup before import; restore archives imported threads
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: preview_import_project_from_home
capabilities.purpose: Preview source project import thread count and rollout bytes without writing target home.

capabilities.name: home_overview
capabilities.purpose: Inventory CODEX_HOME resources such as sessions, memories, skills, AGENTS.md, config and logs.

capabilities.name: read_resource
capabilities.purpose: Read a text resource or list a directory inside CODEX_HOME.

capabilities.name: backup_resource
capabilities.purpose: Create an explicit backup of a CODEX_HOME resource.
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: preview_write_resource
capabilities.purpose: Preview text resource write and protected-path validation without writing.

capabilities.name: write_resource
capabilities.purpose: Write a UTF-8 text resource such as AGENTS.md or memory notes inside CODEX_HOME. Protected state files and session JSONL are rejected.
capabilities.backup: backs up overwritten target resource before write
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: copy_resource_from_home
capabilities.purpose: Copy AGENTS.md, memories, skills or safe text resources from another Codex Home. Protected Codex state files are rejected.
capabilities.backup: backs up overwritten target resource before copy
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: preview_copy_resource_from_home
capabilities.purpose: Preview resource copy size and overwrite impact without writing target home.

capabilities.name: preview_portable_backup_export
capabilities.purpose: Preview creation or replacement of a passphrase-protected Ed25519 portable manifest.

capabilities.name: export_portable_backup
capabilities.purpose: Create a signed portable manifest and encrypted Ed25519 private-key envelope for an existing schema 2 backup.
capabilities.backup: writes portable-manifest.json without changing schema 2 manifest
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: preview_portable_backup_restore
capabilities.purpose: Verify a portable package and explicitly map its signed source Codex Home to the selected current Codex Home.

capabilities.name: restore_portable_backup
capabilities.purpose: Restore a verified portable backup only after explicit source-to-target Codex Home mapping.
capabilities.backup: creates pre_restore backup by default and keeps the portable source package immutable
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

capabilities.name: preview_restore_backup
capabilities.purpose: Preview backup restore notes and bind a restore operation.

capabilities.name: restore_backup
capabilities.purpose: Restore a backup manifest or archive imported/duplicated created threads.
capabilities.idempotency: not idempotent; each successful write creates a backup and may create or move records

safetyModel.deleteBehavior: Thread delete is implemented as archive by default; JSONL files are not permanently deleted.
safetyModel.resourcePathPolicy: Resource APIs accept paths relative to CODEX_HOME and reject absolute paths or .. escapes.
safetyModel.writeResponseContract: Write endpoints return backup.backupId when createBackup=true. When createBackup=false they return backup.skipped=true and no automatic rollback material is created.
safetyModel.concurrencyWarning: Write endpoints include warnings when Codex-related processes are running.
safetyModel.authorization: Write endpoints require X-Codex-Manager-Token. Browser clients can fetch the token from GET /api/auth/token only from the loopback same-origin local UI.
safetyModel.csrfProtection: Unsafe methods reject browser requests outside the loopback same-origin local UI and require a custom token header.
safetyModel.mcp: MCP tools are available at /mcp. Call codex_auth_token before every other tool and pass its short-lived token as apiToken. Preview-bound writes also require the matching operationPreviewId and inputHash.
safetyModel.previewBinding: Dangerous writes require operationPreviewId and inputHash returned by the matching preview endpoint within 10 minutes.
safetyModel.runningCodexWriteGate: When Codex-related processes are running, write endpoints fail with HTTP 409 unless acknowledgeCodexRunningRisk=true is supplied in the query string or JSON body after token and preview validation.
safetyModel.optionalBackups: Automatic backups are enabled by default. Pass createBackup=false for one write when you intentionally do not want rollback material.
safetyModel.operationLock: Write endpoints are serialized by a process-local operation lock.

commonQueryParameters.codex_home: Optional target Codex Home path. Defaults to CODEX_HOME env or the first detected local .codex profile.
commonQueryParameters.sidebar_limit: Legacy Codex Desktop first-page ordering size. Defaults to 50 and is kept only for compatibility diagnostics.
commonQueryParameters.acknowledgeCodexRunningRisk: Required for write endpoints that use query-only actions when Codex-related processes are running.
commonQueryParameters.createBackup: Defaults to true. Set to false on write endpoints to skip automatic backup creation; explicit manual backup endpoints always create backups.
commonQueryParameters.operationPreviewId: Preview id returned by the matching preview endpoint for query-only writes.
commonQueryParameters.inputHash: Input hash returned by the matching preview endpoint for query-only writes.
commonQueryParameters.lang: Capability description language. Use en or zh.
